# Rakibul Hasan

> Rakibul Hasan (O.F.M. Rakibul Hasan, handle rakibulx33) is a freelance backend and automation developer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and a third-year CSE student at Daffodil International University. He has been freelancing since 2022 and is open to freelance projects.

## Services
- Backend systems and APIs (Node.js, Laravel, FastAPI)
- E-commerce for Bangladesh: online stores and admin panels with local payment and delivery options
- Automation and AI integrations: chatbots, n8n workflows, LLM features
- IoT prototypes with ESP32

## Selected public work
- [TradingSpark](https://github.com/rakibulx33/tradingspark): genetic strategy breeding and forward-tested trading on NautilusTrader (Python)
- [Tender Package Builder](https://rakibulx33.github.io/devfest-241-15-223/): in-browser PDF package builder, solo build for AI DevFest 2026 (React, pdf-lib)
- [Smart Escape](https://rakibulx33.github.io/AI-DEV-FEST-2026-VIBE-CODING-MOCK/): evacuation route simulator (JavaScript, SVG)
- [DIU Job Hub](https://github.com/rakibulx33/diujobhub): university job platform with AI job matching (Next.js, MySQL)

## Research (in preparation)
- Smart energy monitoring for Bangladeshi homes (undergraduate thesis)
- IoT monitoring for potato and onion storage (conference papers)
- Device-free human presence sensing (IEEE conference paper)
